delivery.title: Taipitopito Tukunga - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: Ko te "Pass" i konei anake te tikanga i whakahokia mai e te tūmau i whäia he mana HTTP 2xx - kare e whakau i te pünaha whiwhi i penapenahia, i tukatuka ranei i te arataki. Tirohia te tinana whakautu i runga ake mo nga korero i tino korero ai; mena he kore noa, he whakaae noa ranei, tera pea te punaha e whiwhi ana i te tono engari ka paopao, ka warewarehia ranei te utunga o roto (he he nga ingoa mara/whakaahua mo tana API , he mara e hiahiatia ana i tona taha kaore tenei utu e uru, aha atu).

push.title: Webhooks Puwaho - Push Leads & Updates
push.intro: Ka taea te whakarite mo ia webhook : JSON , Puka (x-www-form-urlencoded), o taau ake tauira tinana Ritenga ranei me nga kaipupuri waahi <fieldkey></fieldkey> (hei tauira <example></example> ) - he rite ki te whakaki i te whakahau cURL kotahi.
push.curlLabel: Whakapirihia cURL o to kiritaki CRM
push.curlHelp: Whakapirihia te tauira tono ki a raatau tuhinga API , ka hoatu ranei e Postman ki a koe (me nga raraunga tuturu, tauira ranei). Ko te URL , te tikanga me nga pane ka kape i a ia ano, a ko nga taviri katoa o te tinana kua whakarārangihia i raro nei kia taea ai e koe te kowhiri ko tehea CRM ka whakakiia mo ia kaiarahi.

api.title: To API - Rua-Wae Access mo tetahi Pūnaha
api.intro: Ka taea e nga punaha me to matua API te hanga, te panui me te whakahou i nga kaiarahi me te ohauru ki te arahi i nga huihuinga. Tukua te kī ki roto i te pane <hdr></hdr> , hei <bearer></bearer> , (mehemea kaore e taea e te taputapu te tautuhi pane) hei <query></query> . Tepe: {{limit}} tono mo ia meneti.
api.noPermission: Ko te tangata anake kei a ia te whakaaetanga Manage Settings ka taea te tiro i te kii API .
api.shownOnce: Tāruatia tēnei kī ināianei ka penapena ki tētahi wāhi haumaru - mō te haumaru ka whakaatuhia kotahi anake. Mena kua ngaro, hangaia he mea hou.
